proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Abbott's lobbying policies, payments used for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, trade association memberships, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Report on Racial Justice
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing the company's plan, if any, to promote racial justice, including diversity and inclusion targets and quantitative hiring, retention and promotion data.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.
